prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity native macOS app direction comp, composition variant C
Input image: use the supplied Ledge concept only as the identity reference. Keep its deep-black optical instrument world, fine seams, calm typography, spectral violet signal and hardware-level refinement; change the composition.
Primary request: make the notch and macOS menu bar the dominant architectural spine. The black menu-bar material descends from the centered notch as one smooth tapered body into a medium-width Ledge panel. Navigation is a precise icon-and-label rail integrated into the two shoulders of the notch, never a separate toolbar. The open Media module uses a cinematic full-bleed album image band across the upper third, then a calm black lower control deck with title, progress and playback. Show a subtle three-position edge trace along one side to communicate the morph from notch to peek to expanded without looking like a diagram. Also show a dark Ledge Settings window where sidebar and detail are a single continuous graphite field, with a large live notch preview and sparse aligned controls.
Scene/backdrop: realistic dark macOS desktop, no staged objects.
Color palette: true black, graphite, warm white, violet only for the selected module and playback position.
Materials: seamless black glass, one-pixel metallic seams.
Text: French labels readable where shown.
Constraints: panel remains unmistakably connected to notch and menu bar; fluid spring-like geometry, accessible, native macOS, implementation-minded.
Avoid: floating-card collage, light surfaces, glassmorphism blobs, glow, gradients, neon, rainbow spectrum, excessive technical annotations, tiny text, generic dev console, marketing poster.
